annotation.title_clean: Ethical AI use in the energy sector (version 2)
annotation.title_en: Ethical AI use in the energy sector (version 2)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ofgem (Office of Gas and Electricity Markets)
annotation.summary_en: Ofgem's second-edition good-practice guidance on ethical AI adoption in Great Britain's energy sector, built around safety, security, fairness and sustainability. It covers governance, risk, competencies and sector examples, including a brief cyber-physical systems section on drones and autonomous control. It stresses proportionate, outcomes-based oversight within existing law and strengthens transparency expectations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four outcomes: safety, security, fairness and environmental sustainability.
Existing regulatory framework is considered adequate; guidance is voluntary good practice that complements licence conditions.
Governance practices: board accountability, strategy, leadership, and proportionate transparency and explainability.
Risk practices: life-cycle risk assessment, failure-mode analysis, testing, human oversight, monitoring.
Cyber-physical section covers drones and autonomous control, recommending functional safety and guardrails; AI Reg Lab and a proposed technical sandbox.
